statement.zh: 「urban settlement / ciudad sagrada」用语是否等于跨文化「城市」标准仍属开放争议；本库不排名「美洲第一城」。
statement.en: Whether “urban settlement” / “ciudad sagrada” meets cross-cultural “city” criteria remains open; this archive does not rank “first city in the Americas.”

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
